import { Client } from 'ssh2'
import { readFileSync } from 'fs'
import { cli } from '../cli/wrapper.ts'
import type { SandboxCredentials } from '../cli/types.ts'
import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'
const log = createLogger('ssh')
// ── Error classification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type FailKind = 'auth' | 'transient' | 'unknown'
interface FailState {
  count: number
  lastFail: number
  lastError: string
  kind: FailKind
  suppressed: boolean  // logged the "suppressing" message
}
function classifyError(msg: string): FailKind {
  const m = msg.toLowerCase()
  if (m.includes('forbidden') || m.includes('unauthorized') || m.includes(' 401') || m.includes(' 403'))
    return 'auth'
  if (
    m.includes('dns') || m.includes('lookup') || m.includes('misbehaving') ||
    m.includes('econnrefused') || m.includes('etimedout') || m.includes('enotfound') ||
    m.includes('dial tcp') || m.includes('request failed') || m.includes('socket hang up') ||
    m.includes('timeout') || m.includes('connect econnreset') || m.includes('network')
  ) return 'transient'
  return 'unknown'
}
// Backoff windows per kind
const BACKOFF: Record<FailKind, { max: number; windowMs: number }> = {
  auth:      { max: 3,  windowMs: 5 * 60_000 },
  transient: { max: 20, windowMs: 90_000 },
  unknown:   { max: 3,  windowMs: 5 * 60_000 },
}
// ── Manager ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class SSHManager {
  private connections = new Map<string, Client>()
  private credentials = new Map<string, SandboxCredentials>()
  private pending     = new Map<string, Promise<Client>>()
  private failures    = new Map<string, FailState>()
  // ── Public: get or create connection ──────────────────────────────────────
  async getConnection(projectId: string): Promise<Client> {
    log.debug({ projectId }, 'getConnection called')
    // Back-off gate
    const fail = this.failures.get(projectId)
    if (fail) {
      const { max, windowMs } = BACKOFF[fail.kind]
      if (fail.count >= max && Date.now() - fail.lastFail < windowMs) {
        throw new Error(SSH backed off (${fail.kind}): ${fail.lastError})
      }
    }
    const existing = this.connections.get(projectId)
    if (existing) {
      log.debug({ projectId }, 'returning existing connection')
      return existing
    }
    // Coalesce concurrent callers
    const inFlight = this.pending.get(projectId)
    if (inFlight) return inFlight
    const promise = this._connect(projectId)
    this.pending.set(projectId, promise)
    try {
      const conn = await promise
      if (this.failures.has(projectId)) {
        log.info({ projectId }, 'SSH recovered — clearing failure state')
        this.failures.delete(projectId)
      }
      return conn
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
      const kind = classifyError(msg)
      const prev = this.failures.get(projectId)
      const newCount = prev?.kind === kind ? prev.count + 1 : 1
      const state: FailState = {
        count: newCount,
        lastFail: Date.now(),
        lastError: msg,
        kind,
        suppressed: prev?.suppressed ?? false,
      }
      if (newCount <= 3) {
        log.warn({ projectId, failCount: newCount, kind }, 'SSH connection attempt failed')
      } else if (!state.suppressed) {
        log.warn({ projectId, kind }, SSH failing repeatedly — suppressing further logs until recovered)
        state.suppressed = true
      }
      this.failures.set(projectId, state)
      throw err
    } finally {
      this.pending.delete(projectId)
    }
  }
  // ── Internal: establish a new connection ──────────────────────────────────
  private async _connect(projectId: string): Promise<Client> {
    log.debug({ projectId }, 'no existing connection, acquiring credentials')
    let creds = this.credentials.get(projectId)
    if (!creds) {
      log.debug({ projectId }, 'fetching credentials from CLI')
      const result = await cli.acquireSandbox(projectId)
      if (!result.ok) {
        log.error({ projectId, error: result.error }, 'failed to acquire sandbox credentials')
        throw new Error(result.error.message)
      }
      creds = result.data.sandbox || result.data
      this.credentials.set(projectId, creds)
      log.info({ projectId, host: (creds as any).ipv4, port: (creds as any).sshPort }, 'credentials acquired')
    }
    log.debug({ projectId }, 'creating new SSH connection')
    const conn = new Client()
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      conn.on('ready', resolve)
      conn.on('error', (err) => {
        // Clear cached creds on SSH-level failure so next attempt re-acquires fresh ones
        this.credentials.delete(projectId)
        reject(err)
      })
      const config: any = {
        host:              (creds as any).ipv4      || creds!.host,
        port:              (creds as any).sshPort   || creds!.port,
        username:          (creds as any).sshUsername || creds!.user,
        keepaliveInterval: 10_000,
        keepaliveCountMax: 10,
        readyTimeout:      30_000,
      }
      if ((creds as any).sshPassword)    config.password   = (creds as any).sshPassword
      else if (creds!.key_path) {
        try { config.privateKey = readFileSync(creds!.key_path) } catch { config.privateKey = creds!.key_path }
      } else if ((creds as any).privateKey) config.privateKey = (creds as any).privateKey
      else return reject(new Error('No SSH credentials provided'))
      conn.connect(config)
    })
    const cleanup = () => {
      this.connections.delete(projectId)
      this.credentials.delete(projectId)
      log.debug({ projectId }, 'SSH connection closed/errored')
    }
    conn.on('close', cleanup)
    conn.on('error', cleanup)
    this.connections.set(projectId, conn)
    log.info({ projectId }, 'SSH connection established')
    return conn
  }
  // ── Public helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async exec(projectId: string, command: string): Promise<string> {
    const run = async () => {
      const conn = await this.getConnection(projectId)
      return new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        conn.exec(command, (err, stream) => {
          if (err) return reject(err)
          let stdout = '', stderr = ''
          stream.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { stdout += d.toString() })
          stream.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { stderr += d.toString() })
          stream.on('close', (code: number) => {
            if (code !== 0 && stderr) reject(new Error(Exit ${code}: ${stderr}))
            else resolve(stdout)
          })
        })
      })
    }
    try {
      return await run()
    } catch {
      // Stale connection — evict and retry once
      this.connections.delete(projectId)
      return run()
    }
  }
  async getSFTP(projectId: string) {
    const conn = await this.getConnection(projectId)
    return new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {
      conn.sftp((err, sftp) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(sftp))
    })
  }
  isConnected(projectId: string): boolean {
    return this.connections.has(projectId)
  }
  /** Whether project is in active back-off window */
  isBacked(projectId: string): boolean {
    const fail = this.failures.get(projectId)
    if (!fail) return false
    const { max, windowMs } = BACKOFF[fail.kind]
    return fail.count >= max && Date.now() - fail.lastFail < windowMs
  }
  getFailureKind(projectId: string): FailKind | null {
    return this.failures.get(projectId)?.kind ?? null
  }
  async disconnect(projectId: string) {
    const conn = this.connections.get(projectId)
    if (conn) { conn.end(); this.connections.delete(projectId); this.credentials.delete(projectId) }
    this.failures.delete(projectId)
  }
  async closeConnection(projectId: string) { await this.disconnect(projectId) }
  async closeAll() {
    for (const [, conn] of this.connections) conn.end()
    this.connections.clear()
    this.credentials.clear()
  }
}
export const sshManager = new SSHManager()
ENDSSH

import { sshManager } from './manager.ts'
import { scheduleCapture } from '../continuation/capture.ts'
import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'
const log = createLogger('watcher')
type FileChange = { path: string; action: 'created' | 'modified' | 'deleted' }
type ChangeHandler = (projectId: string, changes: FileChange[]) => void
/** Returns true if the error means the project is permanently inaccessible */
function isPermanentError(msg: string): boolean {
  const m = msg.toLowerCase()
  return (
    m.includes('forbidden') ||
    m.includes('acquiring sandbox failed') ||
    m.includes('ssh backed off (auth)') ||
    m.includes('ssh backed off (unknown)') ||
    m.includes('too many failed')
  )
}
class FileChangeWatcher {
  private intervals = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>()
  private handlers  = new Set<ChangeHandler>()
  start(projectId: string, pollMs = 15_000) {
    if (this.intervals.has(projectId)) return
    log.debug({ projectId, pollMs }, 'starting file watcher')
    // Touch the sentinel file so first poll has a baseline
    sshManager.exec(projectId, 'touch /tmp/.vibecode-check').catch(() => {})
    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const output = await sshManager.exec(projectId,
          find /home/user/workspace -maxdepth 10 -newer /tmp/.vibecode-check -type f \
            \\( -name node_modules -o -name .git \\) -prune -o -print 2>/dev/null;
          touch /tmp/.vibecode-check
        )
        const files = output.split('\n').filter(Boolean)
        if (files.length > 0) {
          const changes: FileChange[] = files.map(f => ({
            path: f.replace('/home/user/workspace', ''),
            action: 'modified' as const,
          }))
          for (const h of this.handlers) h(projectId, changes)
          scheduleCapture(projectId)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = String(err)
        if (isPermanentError(msg)) {
          log.warn({ projectId }, 'file watcher stopping — project inaccessible with current key')
          this.stop(projectId)
        }
        // Transient errors (DNS, timeout) — keep polling, SSH manager handles backoff
      }
    }, pollMs)
    this.intervals.set(projectId, interval)
  }
  stop(projectId?: string) {
    if (projectId) {
      const interval = this.intervals.get(projectId)
      if (interval) {
        clearInterval(interval)
        this.intervals.delete(projectId)
        log.debug({ projectId }, 'file watcher stopped')
      }
    } else {
      for (const [, interval] of this.intervals) clearInterval(interval)
      this.intervals.clear()
    }
  }
  onChange(handler: ChangeHandler) {
    this.handlers.add(handler)
    return () => { this.handlers.delete(handler) }
  }
}
export const fileWatcher = new FileChangeWatcher()
ENDWATCHER

import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'
const log = createLogger('hub')
export type WSMessage =
  | { type: 'subscribe'; channels: string[] }
  | { type: 'unsubscribe'; channels: string[] }
  | { type: 'terminal:input'; terminalId: string; data: string }
  | { type: 'terminal:resize'; terminalId: string; cols: number; rows: number }
  | { type: 'ping' }
class WebSocketHub {
  private clients       = new Set<WebSocket>()
  private subscriptions = new Map<string, Set<WebSocket>>()
  addClient(ws: WebSocket) { this.clients.add(ws) }
  removeClient(ws: WebSocket) {
    this.clients.delete(ws)
    for (const [channel, subs] of this.subscriptions) {
      subs.delete(ws)
      if (subs.size === 0) this.subscriptions.delete(channel)
    }
  }
  subscribe(ws: WebSocket, channels: string[]) {
    for (const channel of channels) {
      if (!this.subscriptions.has(channel)) this.subscriptions.set(channel, new Set())
      this.subscriptions.get(channel)!.add(ws)
    }
    log.trace({ channels, total: this.subscriptions.size }, 'ws subscribed')
  }
  unsubscribe(ws: WebSocket, channels: string[]) {
    for (const channel of channels) {
      this.subscriptions.get(channel)?.delete(ws)
    }
  }
  broadcast(channel: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const subs = this.subscriptions.get(channel)
    if (!subs || subs.size === 0) return
    const payload = JSON.stringify(data)
    let pruned = 0
    for (const ws of subs) {
      if (ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
        subs.delete(ws)
        this.clients.delete(ws)
        pruned++
        continue
      }
      try { ws.send(payload) } catch { subs.delete(ws); this.clients.delete(ws); pruned++ }
    }
    if (subs.size === 0) this.subscriptions.delete(channel)
    if (pruned > 0) log.trace({ channel, pruned }, 'pruned dead ws connections')
  }
  broadcastAll(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const payload = JSON.stringify(data)
    for (const ws of this.clients) {
      try { if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(payload) } catch {}
    }
  }
  handleMessage(ws: WebSocket, raw: string) {
    try {
      const msg = JSON.parse(raw) as WSMessage
      switch (msg.type) {
        case 'subscribe':   this.subscribe(ws, msg.channels); break
        case 'unsubscribe': this.unsubscribe(ws, msg.channels); break
        case 'ping':        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'pong' })); break
        case 'terminal:input':
        case 'terminal:resize':
          this.handleTerminalMessage(msg)
          break
      }
    } catch { /* malformed */ }
  }
  private terminalHandlers = new Map<string, (msg: WSMessage) => void>()
  onTerminal(terminalId: string, handler: (msg: WSMessage) => void) {
    this.terminalHandlers.set(terminalId, handler)
    return () => { this.terminalHandlers.delete(terminalId) }
  }
  private handleTerminalMessage(msg: WSMessage) {
    if ('terminalId' in msg) this.terminalHandlers.get(msg.terminalId)?.(msg)
  }
  get clientCount() { return this.clients.size }
}
export const wsHub = new WebSocketHub()
ENDHUB

import { Hono } from 'hono'
import { cli } from '../cli/wrapper.ts'
import { getDB } from '../state/db.ts'
import { wsHub as hub } from '../ws/hub.ts'

// POST /chat — send message, stream events via WebSocket
chatRouter.post('/', async (c) => {
  const { projectId, model, prompt, sessionId, agentUrl } = await c.req.json<{
    projectId: string; model: string; prompt: string; sessionId?: string; agentUrl?: string
  }>()
  log.info({ projectId, model, sessionId, promptLength: prompt?.length }, 'chat request received')
  if (!projectId || !prompt?.trim()) {
    return c.json({ error: 'projectId and prompt are required' }, 400)
  }
  // Always prefer server-side agentUrl (fresh from last openWorkspace)
  const resolvedAgentUrl = agentUrls.get(projectId) ?? agentUrl
  if (!resolvedAgentUrl) {
    log.warn({ projectId }, 'no agentUrl available — open workspace first')
    return c.json({ error: 'agentUrl not available — open workspace first' }, 400)
  }
  const db = getDB()
  // Resolve or create session
  let activeSessionId = sessionId
  if (!activeSessionId) {
    activeSessionId = crypto.randomUUID()
    log.info({ projectId, sessionId: activeSessionId, title: prompt.slice(0, 60) }, 'creating new session')
    db.prepare(
      INSERT INTO sessions (id, project_id, model, title, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
    ).run(activeSessionId, projectId, model, prompt.slice(0, 60))
  } else {
    db.prepare("UPDATE sessions SET updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?").run(activeSessionId)
  }
  // Store user message
  db.prepare(
    INSERT INTO messages (session_id, role, content, created_at) VALUES (?, 'user', ?, datetime('now'))
  ).run(activeSessionId, prompt)
  // Notify client: streaming started
  hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'chat:stream:start', sessionId: activeSessionId })
  // Stream in background — return sessionId immediately
  ;(async () => {
    const ac = new AbortController()
    streamRegistry.register(activeSessionId!, projectId, ac)
    let fullText     = ''
    let inputTokens  = 0
    let outputTokens = 0
    let creditsExhausted = false
    log.info({ sessionId: activeSessionId, agentUrl: resolvedAgentUrl, model }, 'calling CLI agentSend')
    try {
      for await (const event of cli.agentSend(resolvedAgentUrl, model, prompt, { signal: ac.signal })) {
        hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'chat:event', sessionId: activeSessionId, event })
        if (event.type === 'text' && event.text) {
          fullText += event.text
        } else if (event.type === 'thinking') {
          hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, {
            type: 'chat:reasoning', sessionId: activeSessionId, text: event.thinking?.summary || ''
          })
        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
          inputTokens  = event.input_tokens
          outputTokens = event.output_tokens
          log.info({ sessionId: activeSessionId, inputTokens, outputTokens }, 'stream finished')
        } else if (event.type === 'credits_exhausted') {
          creditsExhausted = true
          log.warn({ sessionId: activeSessionId }, 'credits exhausted')
          await backupCoordinator.backupNow(projectId).catch(() => {})
          hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'credits:exhausted', sessionId: activeSessionId })
          break
        } else if (event.type === 'credits_low') {
          log.warn({ sessionId: activeSessionId, balance: event.balance }, 'credits low')
          hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'credits:low', balance: event.balance })
        }
      }
      log.info({ sessionId: activeSessionId, textLength: fullText.length }, 'CLI stream completed')
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
      // AbortError = user stopped — stop endpoint already broadcast stream:end
      if (ac.signal.aborted) {
        log.info({ sessionId: activeSessionId }, 'stream aborted by user stop')
        if (fullText) {
          db.prepare(
            INSERT INTO messages (session_id, role, content, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, created_at)
            VALUES (?, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?, 'cut_off', datetime('now'))
          ).run(activeSessionId, fullText, inputTokens, outputTokens)
        }
        // Do NOT broadcast stream:end here — stop endpoint already did it
        return
      }
      log.error({ sessionId: activeSessionId, error: msg }, 'stream error')
      hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'chat:stream:error', sessionId: activeSessionId, message: msg })
    } finally {
      streamRegistry.unregister(activeSessionId!)
    }
    // Store assistant message (even partial on cut-off)
    if (fullText) {
      const isCutOff = inputTokens === 0
      db.prepare(
        INSERT INTO messages (session_id, role, content, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, created_at)
        VALUES (?, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
      ).run(activeSessionId, fullText, inputTokens, outputTokens, isCutOff ? 'cut_off' : 'complete')
    }
    // Broadcast stream end
    // cutOff = had content but no done event (genuine cut-off)
    // empty  = no content at all (agent produced nothing)
    const cutOff = fullText.length > 0 && inputTokens === 0
    const empty  = fullText.length === 0
    log.info({ sessionId: activeSessionId, cutOff, empty, creditsExhausted }, 'broadcasting stream end')
    hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, {
      type: 'chat:stream:end',
      sessionId: activeSessionId,
      creditsExhausted,
      cutOff,
      empty,
    })
  })()
  return c.json({ sessionId: activeSessionId })
})

chatRouter.get('/sessions', async (c) => {
  const projectId = c.req.query('projectId')
  if (!projectId) return c.json({ error: 'projectId required' }, 400)

  const db = getDB()

    createdAt: s.created_at, updatedAt: s.updated_at, messageCount: s.message_count,

  return c.json({ sessions })

  if (!sessionRow) return c.json({ error: 'session not found' }, 404)
  const session = {
    id: sessionRow.id, projectId: sessionRow.project_id, model: sessionRow.model,
    title: sessionRow.title, createdAt: sessionRow.created_at, updatedAt: sessionRow.updated_at,
  }
  const messageRows = db.prepare(

    inputTokens: m.input_tokens, outputTokens: m.output_tokens, status: m.status,

  })

  // Abort local stream — background async fn will detect ac.signal.aborted and NOT re-broadcast
  streamRegistry.abort(sessionId, 'user stopped')
  // Broadcast stream:end immediately so UI unlocks right away
  // userStopped: true lets client decide whether to show a banner or just clear state
  hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, {
    type: 'chat:stream:end',
    sessionId,
    cutOff: false,
    empty: false,
    userStopped: true,
  })

  const agentUrl = agentUrls.get(projectId)
  if (agentUrl) {
    const result = await cli.agentStop(agentUrl).catch(() => ({ ok: false }))
    log.info({ projectId, sessionId, agentUrl, stopped: result.ok }, 'remote agent stop requested')
    return c.json({ ok: true, stopped: result.ok })
  }
  return c.json({ ok: true, stopped: false, reason: 'no agentUrl' })
})

import { Hono } from 'hono'
import { createHash } from 'crypto'
import { cli } from '../cli/wrapper.ts'
import { getDB } from '../state/db.ts'
import { loadStoredAuth } from '../state/auth.ts'
import { sshManager } from '../ssh/manager.ts'
import { captureNow, pushToProject } from '../continuation/capture.ts'
import { agentUrls } from './projects.ts'
import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'
import { fileWatcher } from '../ssh/watcher.ts'
const log = createLogger('continuation')
export const continuationRouter = new Hono()
function hashKey(key: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)
}
continuationRouter.get('/status/:projectId', (c) => {
  const { projectId } = c.req.param()
  const db = getDB()
  const row = db.prepare(
    'SELECT api_key_hash, snapshot_dir, snapshot_at FROM projects WHERE id = ?'
  ).get(projectId) as any
  if (!row) return c.json({ error: 'not found' }, 404)
  const auth = loadStoredAuth()
  const currentHash = auth?.key ? hashKey(auth.key) : null
  const needsContinuation = !!(row.api_key_hash && currentHash && row.api_key_hash !== currentHash)
  return c.json({ snapshotDir: row.snapshot_dir, snapshotAt: row.snapshot_at, needsContinuation })
})
continuationRouter.post('/capture/:projectId', async (c) => {
  const { projectId } = c.req.param()
  try {
    const count = await captureNow(projectId)
    return c.json({ ok: true, fileCount: count })
  } catch (err) {
    return c.json({ error: String(err) }, 500)
  }
})
continuationRouter.post('/enact', async (c) => {
  const { sourceProjectId } = await c.req.json()
  if (!sourceProjectId) return c.json({ error: 'sourceProjectId required' }, 400)
  const db = getDB()
  const source = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ?').get(sourceProjectId) as any
  if (!source) return c.json({ error: 'Source project not found' }, 404)
  const auth = loadStoredAuth()
  if (!auth?.key) return c.json({ error: 'No API key configured' }, 401)
  log.info({ sourceProjectId, name: source.name }, 'enacting continuation')
  try {
    // Create new project under current key
    const name = source.name || 'Continued Project'
    const result = await cli.createProject(name, { description: source.description || name })
    if (!result.ok) return c.json({ error: result.error.message }, 500)
    const newProjectId = result.data.id
    // Verify project actually exists — cli.listProjects returns data as array directly
    const verify = await cli.listProjects()
    if (verify.ok && Array.isArray(verify.data)) {
      const exists = verify.data.some((p: any) => p.id === newProjectId)
      if (!exists) {
        log.error({ newProjectId }, 'project created but not found in list — may have failed')
        return c.json({ error: 'Project creation failed — not found after creation' }, 500)
      }
    }
    const newHash = hashKey(auth.key)
    // Register in local DB
    db.prepare(
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO projects (id, name, description, default_model, api_key_hash)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ).run(newProjectId, name, source.description || '', source.default_model || 'claude-sonnet-4-6', newHash)
    // Acquire sandbox; push files in background if snapshot exists
    const wsResult = await cli.acquireSandbox(newProjectId)
    if (wsResult.ok) {
      const { links } = wsResult.data
      if (links?.agentUrl?.url) agentUrls.set(newProjectId, links.agentUrl.url)
      if (source.snapshot_dir) {
        sshManager.getConnection(newProjectId)
          .then(() => pushToProject(sourceProjectId, newProjectId))
          .then(() => log.info({ newProjectId }, 'files pushed successfully'))
          .catch((e) => log.warn({ newProjectId, err: String(e) }, 'file push failed (non-fatal)'))
      }
    }
    log.info({ sourceProjectId, newProjectId }, 'continuation complete')
    // Clean up the old orphaned project
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = ?').run(sourceProjectId)
    fileWatcher.stop(sourceProjectId)
    sshManager.closeConnection(sourceProjectId).catch(() => {})
    agentUrls.delete(sourceProjectId)
    log.info({ sourceProjectId }, 'deleted orphaned project from local DB')
    return c.json({ ok: true, newProjectId, name })
  } catch (err) {
    log.error({ err: String(err) }, 'continuation failed')
    return c.json({ error: String(err) }, 500)
  }
})

const server = Bun.serve({
  port: PORT,
  fetch(req, server) {
    const url = new URL(req.url)
    if (url.pathname === '/ws/logs') {
      const ok = server.upgrade(req, { data: { type: 'logs' } })
      return ok ? undefined : new Response('WebSocket upgrade failed', { status: 400 })
    }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/ws/project/')) {
      const projectId = url.pathname.split('/ws/project/')[1]
      const ok = server.upgrade(req, { data: { type: 'hub', projectId } })
      return ok ? undefined : new Response('WebSocket upgrade failed', { status: 400 })
    }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/ws/terminal/')) {
      const projectId = url.pathname.split('/')[3]
      const ok = server.upgrade(req, { data: { type: 'terminal', projectId } })
      return ok ? undefined : new Response('WebSocket upgrade failed', { status: 400 })
    }
    return app.fetch(req)
  },
  websocket: {
    open(ws) {
      const { type, projectId } = ws.data as any
      if (type === 'logs') {
        const { addBrowserLogClient } = require('./lib/logger.ts')
        addBrowserLogClient(ws)
        return
      }
      if (type === 'hub') {
        hub.subscribe(ws as any, [project:${projectId}])
        hub.broadcast(project:${projectId}, { type: 'ws:connected' })
        if (projectId && projectId !== 'null' && projectId !== 'undefined') {
          const exists = getDB().prepare('SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = ?').get(projectId)
          if (exists) fileWatcher.start(projectId)
        }
        return
      }
      if (type === 'terminal') {
        sshManager.getConnection(projectId).then(conn => {
          conn.shell({ term: 'xterm-256color', cols: 80, rows: 24 }, (err, stream) => {
            if (err) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'terminal:error', message: err.message })); ws.close(); return }
            ;(ws as any).__termStream = stream
            stream.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => ws.send(chunk))
            stream.stderr.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => ws.send(chunk))
            stream.on('close', () => ws.close())
          })
        }).catch(err => {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'terminal:error', message: err.message }))
          ws.close()
        })
      }
    },
    message(ws, data) {
      const { type } = ws.data as any
      if (type === 'hub' && typeof data === 'string') {
        hub.handleMessage(ws as any, data)
        return
      }
      if (type === 'terminal') {
        const stream = (ws as any).__termStream
        if (!stream) return
        if (typeof data === 'string') {
          try {
            const msg = JSON.parse(data)
            if (msg.type === 'terminal:resize') stream.setWindow(msg.rows, msg.cols, 0, 0)
            else if (msg.type === 'terminal:input') stream.write(msg.data)
          } catch { stream.write(data) }
        } else {
          stream.write(Buffer.from(data as ArrayBuffer))
        }
      }
    },
    close(ws) {
      const { type, projectId } = ws.data as any
      if (type === 'logs') {
        const { removeBrowserLogClient } = require('./lib/logger.ts')
        removeBrowserLogClient(ws)
      } else if (type === 'hub') {
        hub.unsubscribe(ws as any, [project:${projectId}])
      } else if (type === 'terminal') {
        const stream = (ws as any).__termStream
        if (stream) stream.end()
      }
    },
  },
})

import { create } from 'zustand'
export interface Message {
  id: string
  role: 'user' | 'assistant'
  content: string
  createdAt: string
  inputTokens?: number
  outputTokens?: number
  streaming?: boolean
  cutOff?: boolean
  empty?: boolean       // agent returned no content at all
  userStopped?: boolean // user explicitly stopped — no banner needed
}
export interface ToolCall {
  id: string
  name: string
  input: any
  result?: string
  status: 'running' | 'success' | 'error'
  messageId?: string
}
export interface ChatSession {
  id: string
  projectId: string
  model: string
  title: string
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
  messageCount?: number
}
interface ChatState {
  sessions: ChatSession[]
  activeSessionId: string | null
  messages: Message[]
  streamingText: string
  isStreaming: boolean
  creditsExhausted: boolean
  model: string
  toolCalls: ToolCall[]
  setSessions: (sessions: ChatSession[]) => void
  setActiveSession: (id: string | null) => void
  setMessages: (messages: Message[]) => void
  addMessage: (msg: Message) => void
  appendStreamText: (text: string) => void
  finalizeStream: (content: string, opts?: { cutOff?: boolean; empty?: boolean; userStopped?: boolean }) => void
  setStreaming: (v: boolean) => void
  setCreditsExhausted: (v: boolean) => void
  setModel: (model: string) => void
  addToolCall: (toolCall: ToolCall) => void
  updateToolCall: (id: string, updates: Partial<ToolCall>) => void
  clearToolCalls: () => void
  reset: () => void
}
export const useChatStore = create<ChatState>((set, get) => ({
  sessions: [],
  activeSessionId: null,
  messages: [],
  streamingText: '',
  isStreaming: false,
  creditsExhausted: false,
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
  toolCalls: [],
  setSessions: (sessions) => set({ sessions }),
  setActiveSession: (id) => {
    set({ activeSessionId: id })
    if (id) localStorage.setItem('activeSessionId', id)
    else localStorage.removeItem('activeSessionId')
  },
  setMessages: (messages) => set({ messages }),
  addMessage: (msg) => set(s => ({ messages: [...s.messages, msg] })),
  appendStreamText: (text) => set(s => ({ streamingText: s.streamingText + text })),
  finalizeStream: (content, opts = {}) => {
    const { cutOff = false, empty = false, userStopped = false } = opts
    // If user stopped with no content — just clear streaming state, don't add phantom message
    if (userStopped && !content.trim()) {
      set({ streamingText: '', isStreaming: false })
      return
    }
    const msgId    = crypto.randomUUID()
    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString()
    set(s => ({
      streamingText: '',
      isStreaming:   false,
      messages: [...s.messages, {
        id: msgId, role: 'assistant', content: content || '',
        createdAt, cutOff, empty, userStopped,
      }],
      // Assign any orphaned tool calls to this message
      toolCalls: s.toolCalls.map(tc => tc.messageId ? tc : { ...tc, messageId: msgId }),
    }))
  },
  setStreaming: (v) => set({ isStreaming: v }),
  setCreditsExhausted: (v) => set({ creditsExhausted: v }),
  setModel: (model) => set({ model }),
  addToolCall: (toolCall) => set(s => ({ toolCalls: [...s.toolCalls, toolCall] })),
  updateToolCall: (id, updates) => set(s => ({
    toolCalls: s.toolCalls.map(tc => tc.id === id ? { ...tc, ...updates } : tc)
  })),
  clearToolCalls: () => set({ toolCalls: [] }),
  reset: () => set({ sessions: [], activeSessionId: null, messages: [], streamingText: '', isStreaming: false, toolCalls: [] }),
}))
ENDCHATSTORE

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { getProjectWS } from '../lib/ws'
import { useChatStore } from '../store/chat'
import { useAuthStore } from '../store/auth'
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../store/workspace'
export function useProjectEvents(projectId: string | null) {
  const {
    appendStreamText, finalizeStream, setStreaming, setCreditsExhausted,
    addToolCall, updateToolCall, clearToolCalls,
  } = useChatStore()
  const { setCredits } = useAuthStore()
  const { notifyFileChanged } = useWorkspaceStore()
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!projectId) return
    const ws = getProjectWS(projectId)
    let accumulated = ''
    const handleMessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const event = JSON.parse(e.data)
        switch (event.type) {
          case 'chat:stream:start':
            accumulated = ''
            setStreaming(true)
            clearToolCalls()
            break
          case 'chat:event':
            if (event.event?.type === 'text' && event.event.text) {
              accumulated += event.event.text
              appendStreamText(event.event.text)
            } else if (event.event?.type === 'tool_use') {
              addToolCall({
                id: event.event.id, name: event.event.name,
                input: event.event.input, status: 'running',
              })
            } else if (event.event?.type === 'tool_result') {
              const content = typeof event.event.content === 'string'
                ? event.event.content
                : JSON.stringify(event.event.content)
              updateToolCall(event.event.tool_use_id, {
                result: content,
                status: event.event.is_error ? 'error' : 'success',
              })
            }
            break
          case 'chat:stream:end': {
            const userStopped  = Boolean(event.userStopped)
            const cutOff       = Boolean(event.cutOff)
            const empty        = Boolean(event.empty) || (!accumulated.trim() && !cutOff && !userStopped)
            finalizeStream(accumulated, { cutOff, empty, userStopped })
            accumulated = ''
            notifyFileChanged()
            break
          }
          case 'chat:stream:error':
            finalizeStream(accumulated, { cutOff: true })
            accumulated = ''
            break
          case 'credits:exhausted':
            setCreditsExhausted(true)
            break
          case 'credits:update':
            if (event.credits) setCredits(event.credits)
            break
          case 'file:changed':
            notifyFileChanged()
            break
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[ws] parse error:', err)
      }
    }
    ws.addEventListener('message', handleMessage)
    return () => ws.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage)
  }, [projectId])
}

              let lastUserIdx = -1
              if (msg.role === 'assistant' && isLastMsg && !isStreaming) {
                for (let i = idx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                  if (messages[i].role === 'user') { lastUserIdx = i; break }
                }

                    message={msg}
                    onRetry={

                color: 'rgba(255,159,10,0.6)',

              onSend={sendMessage}
              projectId={projectId}

              }}
            />
          )}

        onClose={() => setShowKeyRecovery(false)}
        onRecovered={() => {

          api.listSessions(projectId).then(({ sessions: s }) => setSessions(s)).catch(() => {})
        }}
        projectId={projectId}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

// ── Code block ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CodeBlock({ code, lang }: { code: string; lang: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  const copy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
  }
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden my-3" style={{ background: '#0b0b10', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)' }}>
      <div
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2"
        style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.025)', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}

          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-all duration-200"

#30d158' : 'rgba(235,235,245,0.32)' }}

            ? <><CheckSm /> Copied</>
            : <><CopySm /> Copy</>
          }

        <code>{code}</code>
      </pre>
    </div>
  )

// ── Inline markdown ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderSpans(text: string): React.ReactNode {
  const parts = text.split(/(
[^\n]+|\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*\n]+\*)/g)
  return parts.map((p, i) => {
    if (p.startsWith('') && p.endsWith('') && p.length > 2)
      return <code key={i} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono text-[0.85em]" style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', color: '#ff9f0a' }}>{p.slice(1,-1)}</code>
    if (p.startsWith('**') && p.endsWith('**'))
      return <strong key={i} className="font-semibold" style={{ color: 'white' }}>{p.slice(2,-2)}</strong>
    if (p.startsWith('*') && p.endsWith('*') && p.length > 2)
      return <em key={i} className="italic" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' }}>{p.slice(1,-1)}</em>
    return p
  })
}
function renderMarkdown(text: string): React.ReactNode {
  const parts = text.split(/(```[\s\S]*?```)/g)
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5">
      {parts.map((part, i) => {
        if (part.startsWith('```')) {
          const lines = part.slice(3).split('\n')
          const lang  = lines[0].trim()
          const code  = lines.slice(1).join('\n').replace(/```$/, '').trimEnd()
          return <CodeBlock key={i} code={code} lang={lang} />
        }
        if (!part.trim()) return null
        return part.split(/\n\n+/).map((para, pi) => {
          if (!para.trim()) return null
          const lines = para.split('\n')
          if (lines.every(l => /^\d+\.\s/.test(l.trim()) || !l.trim())) {
            return (
              <ol key={${i}-${pi}} className="space-y-1.5 pl-0">
                {lines.filter(l => l.trim()).map((l, li) => (
                  <li key={li} className="flex gap-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.72)' }}>
                    <span className="flex-shrink-0 font-mono text-[12px] mt-0.5 w-4 text-right" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' }}>{li+1}.</span>
                    <span>{renderSpans(l.replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, ''))}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )
          }
          if (lines.every(l => /^[-*•]\s/.test(l.trim()) || !l.trim())) {
            return (
              <ul key={${i}-${pi}} className="space-y-1.5 pl-0">
                {lines.filter(l => l.trim()).map((l, li) => (
                  <li key={li} className="flex gap-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.72)' }}>
                    <span className="flex-shrink-0 mt-[10px] w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', display: 'block' }} />
                    <span>{renderSpans(l.replace(/^[-*•]\s+/, ''))}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )
          }
          if (lines.length === 1 && /^#{1,3}\s/.test(para)) {
            const level   = para.match(/^(#+)/)?.[1].length ?? 1
            const content = para.replace(/^#+\s/, '')
            const style   = level === 1
              ? { fontSize: '17px', fontWeight: '600', color: 'white', marginTop: '12px', marginBottom: '4px' }
              : level === 2
              ? { fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: '600', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)', marginTop: '8px' }
              : { fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: '500', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.78)', marginTop: '6px' }
            return <p key={${i}-${pi}} style={style}>{renderSpans(content)}</p>
          }
          return (
            <p key={${i}-${pi}} className="text-[15px] leading-[1.78] whitespace-pre-wrap break-words" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.72)' }}>
              {renderSpans(para)}
            </p>
          )
        })
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

function ActionBtn({

  activeColor?: string
  children: React.ReactNode

export function MessageBubble({ message, onRetry, onContinue }: {
  message: Message
  onRetry?: () => void
  onContinue?: () => void
}) {
  const [copied,   setCopied]   = useState(false)
  const [retrying, setRetrying] = useState(false)
  const copy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(message.content)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
  }
  const handleRetry = async () => {
    if (retrying || !onRetry) return
    setRetrying(true)
    try { await onRetry() } finally { setRetrying(false) }
  }
  // ── User bubble ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (message.role === 'user') {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5" style={{ animation: 'fadeIn 0.18s ease' }}>
        <div className="group relative max-w-[84%]">
          <div
            className="text-white rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm px-4 py-3 text-[15px] leading-[1.65] whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"
            style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0a84ff 0%, #0060cc 100%)' }}
          >
            {message.content}
          </div>
          {/* Hover actions */}
          <div
            className="absolute -bottom-9 right-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200"
          >
            <ActionBtn onClick={copy} active={copied} activeColor="#30d158">
              {copied ? <><CheckIcon color="#30d158" />Copied</> : <><CopyIcon />Copy</>}
            </ActionBtn>
            {onRetry && (
              <ActionBtn onClick={handleRetry} active={retrying} activeColor="#0a84ff">
                <RetryIcon />
                {retrying ? 'Retrying...' : 'Retry'}
              </ActionBtn>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
  // ── Assistant bubble ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-3 group" style={{ animation: 'fadeIn 0.22s ease' }}>
      {/* Avatar */}
      <div
        className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0a84ff 0%, #6e40c9 100%)' }}
      >
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
          <path d="M13 2L3 14h8l-1 8 10-12h-8l1-8z"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pt-0.5">
        {/* Streaming content */}
        {message.streaming ? (
          <div>
            {renderMarkdown(message.content)}
            <span
              className="inline-block w-[2px] h-[1.1em] ml-0.5 align-middle rounded-sm"
              style={{ background: '#0a84ff', animation: 'pulse 0.9s ease-in-out infinite' }}
            />
          </div>
        ) : message.content ? (
          renderMarkdown(message.content)
        ) : null}
        {/* Token count */}
        {message.inputTokens != null && (
          <p className="text-[11px] mt-2 font-mono" style={{ color: 'rgba(235,235,245,0.16)' }}>
            {message.inputTokens.toLocaleString()} in · {message.outputTokens?.toLocaleString()} out
          </p>
        )}
        {/* Empty response banner — agent returned nothing */}
        {!message.content && !message.streaming && !message.userStopped && (
          <Banner
            color="rgba(255,69,58"
            icon={<WarnIcon />}
            text="Agent returned no response"
            action={onRetry ? { label: 'Retry', icon: <RetryIcon />, onClick: onRetry, color: '#ff453a' } : undefined}
          />
        )}
        {/* Cut-off banner — had content but was interrupted non-voluntarily */}
        {message.content && message.cutOff && !message.streaming && !message.userStopped && (
          <Banner
            color="rgba(255,159,10"
            icon={<WarnIcon />}
            text="Response was cut off"
            action={onContinue ? { label: 'Continue', icon: <ContinueIcon />, onClick: onContinue, color: '#0a84ff' } : undefined}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {/* Copy — hover only */}
      {!message.streaming && message.content && (
        <div className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150">
          <ActionBtn onClick={copy} active={copied} activeColor="#30d158">
            {copied ? <CheckIcon color="#30d158" /> : <CopyIcon />}
          </ActionBtn>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
function Banner({ color, icon, text, action }: {
  color: string
  icon: React.ReactNode
  text: string
  action?: { label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; onClick: () => void; color: string }
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"
      style={{
        background: ${color},0.06),
        border:     1px solid ${color},0.14),
        animation:  'fadeIn 0.25s ease',
      }}
    >
      <span style={{ color: ${color},0.65) }}>{icon}</span>
      <span className="text-[12.5px] flex-1" style={{ color: ${color},0.65) }}>{text}</span>
      {action && (
        <button
          onClick={action.onClick}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 px-3 rounded-xl text-[12.5px] font-medium transition-all duration-150"
          style={{ background: ${color},0.1), border: 1px solid ${color},0.22), color: action.color }}
          onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = ${color},0.18) }}
          onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = ${color},0.1) }}
        >
          {action.icon}
          {action.label}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

const TOOL_META: Record<string, { icon: any; colorRgb: string }> = {
  shell: { icon: Terminal,  colorRgb: '90,200,250' },
  read:  { icon: FileText,  colorRgb: '48,209,88'  },
  write: { icon: Code,      colorRgb: '255,159,10' },
  glob:  { icon: Search,    colorRgb: '191,90,242' },
  grep:  { icon: Search,    colorRgb: '191,90,242' },
  code:  { icon: Code,      colorRgb: '10,132,255' },
}
const DEFAULT_META = { icon: Wrench, colorRgb: '255,255,255' }
function getInputSummary(name: string, input: any): string {
  if (!input) return ''
  if (name === 'shell') return input.command ?? ''
  if (name === 'read')  return input.operations?.[0]?.path || input.path || ''
  if (name === 'write') return input.path ?? ''
  if (name === 'glob')  return input.pattern ?? ''
  if (name === 'grep')  return input.pattern ?? ''
  if (name === 'code')  return input.operation ?? ''
  const s = JSON.stringify(input)
  return s.length > 60 ? s.slice(0, 60) + '...' : s
}
export function ToolCallCard({ name, input, result, status }: ToolCallCardProps) {
  const meta       = TOOL_META[name] || DEFAULT_META
  const { icon: Icon, colorRgb } = meta
  const summary    = getInputSummary(name, input)
  const safeResult = typeof result === 'string' ? result : result ? JSON.stringify(result) : ''
  const statusIcon  = status === 'running' ? Loader2 : status === 'success' ? CheckCircle : XCircle
  const StatusIcon  = statusIcon
  const statusColor = status === 'running' ? '#5ac8fa' : status === 'success' ? '#30d158' : '#ff453a'
  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all"
      style={{
        background:   'rgba(13,13,20,0.7)',
        border:       status === 'running'
          ? 1px solid rgba(${colorRgb},0.2)
          : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
      }}
    >
      <div className="px-3 py-2.5">
        {/* Header row */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div
            className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
            style={{ background: rgba(${colorRgb},0.12), border: 1px solid rgba(${colorRgb},0.2) }}
          >
            <Icon size={12} style={{ color: rgb(${colorRgb}) }} />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
            {name}
          </span>
          {summary && (
            <span
              className="flex-1 text-[11.5px] font-mono truncate"
              style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)' }}
            >
              {summary}
            </span>
          )}
          <StatusIcon
            size={13}
            style={{ color: statusColor, flexShrink: 0 }}
            className={cn(status === 'running' && 'animate-spin')}
          />
        </div>
        {/* Result — collapsed view */}
        {safeResult && status !== 'running' && (
          <div
            className="mt-2 ml-8 text-[11px] font-mono rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 max-h-16 overflow-hidden"
            style={{
              background: status === 'success' ? 'rgba(48,209,88,0.05)' : 'rgba(255,69,58,0.05)',

            }}
          >
            {safeResult.slice(0, 280)}{safeResult.length > 280 && '...'}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { ArrowUp } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils'
interface Props {
  onSend: (text: string) => void
  projectId: string
  isStreaming?: boolean
  onStop?: () => void
}
export function ChatInput({ onSend, projectId, isStreaming, onStop }: Props) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const ref = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null)
  const submit = useCallback(() => {
    const t = text.trim()
    if (!t || isStreaming) return
    onSend(t)
    setText('')
    if (ref.current) ref.current.style.height = 'auto'
  }, [text, onSend, isStreaming])
  const handleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !isStreaming) { e.preventDefault(); submit() }
  }
  const handleInput = () => {
    const ta = ref.current
    if (!ta) return
    ta.style.height = 'auto'
    ta.style.height = ${Math.min(ta.scrollHeight, 200)}px
  }
  const canSend = !isStreaming && !!text.trim()
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'relative flex flex-col rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-200',
      )}
      style={{
        background: '#111116',
        borderColor: canSend
          ? 'rgba(10,132,255,0.45)'
          : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
        boxShadow: canSend ? '0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,0.07)' : undefined,
      }}
    >
      <textarea
        ref={ref}
        value={text}
        onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={handleKey}
        onInput={handleInput}
        placeholder="Message the agent..."
        rows={1}
        className="w-full bg-transparent resize-none text-[15px] focus:outline-none leading-relaxed px-5 pt-4 pb-14 max-h-[200px] overflow-y-auto"
        style={{ color: 'white' }}
        onFocus={e => {
          const el = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).parentElement
          if (el && !canSend) el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)'
        }}
        onBlur={e => {
          const el = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).parentElement
          if (el && !canSend) el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
        }}
      />
      <div className="absolute bottom-3.5 left-5 right-4 flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none">
        <span className="text-[12px]" style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)' }}>
          {text.length > 0 ? ${text.length} chars` : 'Shift + Enter for new line'}
        </span>
        {isStreaming ? (
          <button
            onClick={onStop}
            className="pointer-events-auto w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-150"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(255,69,58,0.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,69,58,0.2)' }}
            onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = 'rgba(255,69,58,0.22)' }}
            onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = 'rgba(255,69,58,0.12)' }}
            title="Stop agent"
          >
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style={{ background: '#ff453a' }} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            onClick={submit}
            disabled={!canSend}
            className={cn(
              'pointer-events-auto w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-150',
              canSend ? 'active:scale-95' : 'cursor-not-allowed'
            )}
            style={{
              background: canSend ? '
#0a84ff' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
              color:      canSend ? 'white' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
            }}
          >
            <ArrowUp size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import pino from 'pino'
import { build as buildPretty } from 'pino-pretty'
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, createWriteStream } from 'fs'
import { join } from 'path'
import { Writable } from 'stream'

const logsDir = join(process.cwd(), 'logs')
if (!existsSync(logsDir)) mkdirSync(logsDir, { recursive: true })

const browserClients = new Set<any>()

const browserStream = new Writable({
  write(chunk: Buffer, _enc, cb) {
    const line = chunk.toString().trim()
    if (!line) return cb()
    try {
      const log = JSON.parse(line)
      // Only forward info+ to browser to avoid noise
      if (log.level < 30) return cb()
      const payload = JSON.stringify({ type: 'log', level: log.level, message: log.msg, data: log })
      for (const ws of browserClients) {
        try { ws.send(payload) } catch {}
      }
    } catch {}
    cb()
  }
})

const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
const prettyStream = buildPretty({
  colorize: true,
  translateTime: 'HH:MM:ss',
  ignore: 'pid,hostname',
  // In production only show info+; in dev show debug+
  minimumLevel: isDev ? 'debug' : 'info',
})
const fileStream = createWriteStream(join(logsDir, 'app.log'), { flags: 'a' })

const multiStream = pino.multistream([
  { stream: prettyStream, level: isDev ? 'debug' : 'info' },
  { stream: fileStream,   level: 'debug' },
  { stream: browserStream, level: 'info' },
])

export const logger = pino({ level: 'debug' }, multiStream)

export const addBrowserLogClient    = (ws: any) => browserClients.add(ws)
export const removeBrowserLogClient = (ws: any) => browserClients.delete(ws)
export const createLogger           = (component: string) => logger.child({ component })
EOF

const BASE_WS = import.meta.env.DEV ? 'ws://localhost:3847' : `ws://${location.host}`

const connections    = new Map<string, WebSocket>()
const reconnectTimers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

export function getProjectWS(projectId: string): WebSocket {
  const existing = connections.get(projectId)
  if (existing && existing.readyState <= WebSocket.OPEN) return existing

  const ws = new WebSocket(`${BASE_WS}/ws/project/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`)

  ws.addEventListener('open', () => {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'subscribe', channels: [`project:${projectId}`] }))
    const timer = reconnectTimers.get(projectId)
    if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); reconnectTimers.delete(projectId) }
  })

  ws.addEventListener('close', () => {
    connections.delete(projectId)
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      reconnectTimers.delete(projectId)
      getProjectWS(projectId)
    }, 2500)
    reconnectTimers.set(projectId, timer)
  })

  ws.addEventListener('error', () => { /* close event will handle reconnect */ })

  connections.set(projectId, ws)
  return ws
}

export function closeProjectWS(projectId: string) {
  const timer = reconnectTimers.get(projectId)
  if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); reconnectTimers.delete(projectId) }
  const ws = connections.get(projectId)
  if (ws) { ws.close(); connections.delete(projectId) }
}

export function terminalWSUrl(projectId: string): string {
  return `${BASE_WS}/ws/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}`
}
EOF

const BASE_WS = import.meta.env.DEV ? 'ws://localhost:3847' : `ws://${location.host}`

export interface LogEntry {
  time: number
  level: number
  component: string
  msg: string
  raw: Record<string, unknown>
}

const MAX_LOGS = 2000
const logs: LogEntry[] = []
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

export const getLogs      = (): LogEntry[] => logs
export const clearLogs    = () => { logs.splice(0); listeners.forEach(fn => fn()) }
export const onLogsChange = (fn: () => void) => { listeners.add(fn); return () => listeners.delete(fn) }

/** Only log in dev mode to avoid UI noise in production */
export function addClientLog(component: string, msg: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return
  const entry: LogEntry = {
    time: Date.now(), level: 20,
    component: `client:${component}`, msg, raw: data ?? {},
  }
  logs.push(entry)
  if (logs.length > MAX_LOGS) logs.splice(0, logs.length - MAX_LOGS)
  listeners.forEach(fn => fn())
}

let logWs: WebSocket | null = null

export function connectServerLogs() {
  if (logWs) return
  logWs = new WebSocket(`${BASE_WS}/ws/logs`)
  logWs.addEventListener('message', (e: MessageEvent) => {
    try {
      const { level, message, data } = JSON.parse(e.data)
      const entry: LogEntry = {
        time: Date.now(), level,
        component: data?.component ?? 'server',
        msg: message, raw: data ?? {},
      }
      logs.push(entry)
      if (logs.length > MAX_LOGS) logs.splice(0, logs.length - MAX_LOGS)
      listeners.forEach(fn => fn())
    } catch {}
  })
  logWs.addEventListener('close', () => { logWs = null })
}

              onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = '' }}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleContinue}
              disabled={migrating || done}
              className="flex-1 h-11 rounded-xl text-black text-[14px] font-semibold transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              style={{ background: migrating ? '#ff9f0a' : '#ff9f0a' }}
              onMouseEnter={e => { if (!migrating && !done) (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = '#ffb340' }}
              onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background = '#ff9f0a' }}
            >
              {migrating
                ? <><Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />Migrating...</>
                : <><ArrowRight size={15} />Continue with Current Key</>
              }
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

import { Hono } from 'hono'
import { createHash } from 'crypto'
import { cli } from '../cli/wrapper.ts'
import { getDB } from '../state/db.ts'
import { loadStoredAuth } from '../state/auth.ts'
import { sshManager } from '../ssh/manager.ts'
import { backupCoordinator } from '../backup/coordinator.ts'
import { wsHub as hub } from '../ws/hub.ts'
import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'

function hashKey(key: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)
}

const log = createLogger('projects')

// Server-side agentUrl store — always fresh from last openWorkspace
export const agentUrls = new Map<string, string>()

export const projectsRouter = new Hono()

projectsRouter.get('/', async (c) => {
  log.debug({}, 'listing projects')
  const db = getDB()
  const localProjects = db.prepare(
    'SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY last_opened_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC'
  ).all() as any[]

  // Enrich with remote data where available — cli.listProjects returns data as array
  const cliResult = await cli.listProjects()
  const remoteMap = new Map<string, any>()
  if (cliResult.ok && Array.isArray(cliResult.data)) {
    for (const p of cliResult.data) remoteMap.set(p.id, p)
  }

  const auth = loadStoredAuth()
  const currentHash = auth?.key ? hashKey(auth.key) : null

  const projects = localProjects.map((p) => {
    const remote = remoteMap.get(p.id)
    const differentKey = !!(p.api_key_hash && currentHash && p.api_key_hash !== currentHash)
    return {
      id: p.id, name: p.name, description: p.description,
      sandbox: remote?.sandbox || { status: 'stopped' },
      defaultModel: p.default_model ?? 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
      lastOpenedAt: p.last_opened_at ?? null,
      differentKey,
      snapshotAt: p.snapshot_at ?? null,
      created_at: p.created_at, updated_at: p.updated_at,
    }
  })

  log.info({ count: projects.length }, 'projects listed successfully')
  return c.json({ projects })
})

projectsRouter.post('/', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json()
  const { name, description, template, defaultModel } = body
  log.info({ name, template }, 'creating new project')
  if (!name?.trim()) return c.json({ error: 'name is required' }, 400)

  const result = await cli.createProject(name.trim(), { description, template })
  if (!result.ok) return c.json({ error: result.error }, 500)

  const db = getDB()
  const keyHash = (() => { const a = loadStoredAuth(); return a?.key ? hashKey(a.key) : null })()
  db.prepare(
    'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO projects (id, name, description, default_model, api_key_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
  ).run(result.data.id, name.trim(), description ?? null, defaultModel ?? 'claude-sonnet-4-6', keyHash)

  log.info({ projectId: result.data.id }, 'project created')
  return c.json({ project: result.data })
})

projectsRouter.delete('/:projectId', async (c) => {
  const { projectId } = c.req.param()
  log.info({ projectId }, 'deleting project')
  const result = await cli.deleteProject(projectId)
  if (!result.ok) return c.json({ error: result.error }, 500)
  const db = getDB()
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE project_id = ?').run(projectId)
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = ?').run(projectId)
  log.info({ projectId }, 'project deleted')
  return c.json({ ok: true })
})

projectsRouter.post('/:projectId/open', async (c) => {
  const { projectId } = c.req.param()
  log.info({ projectId }, 'opening workspace - acquiring sandbox')

  const db = getDB()
  db.prepare("UPDATE projects SET last_opened_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?").run(projectId)
  log.debug({ projectId }, 'updated last opened timestamp')

  log.debug({ projectId }, 'calling CLI acquireSandbox')
  const result = await cli.acquireSandbox(projectId)
  if (!result.ok) {
    const errMsg: string = result.error?.message || String(result.error)
    log.error({ projectId, error: result.error }, 'failed to acquire sandbox')

    // If Forbidden, this project likely belongs to a different API key
    if (errMsg.toLowerCase().includes('forbidden') || errMsg.includes('403')) {
      log.info({ projectId }, 'project not found under current key — activating continuation flow')
      return c.json({ error: 'forbidden', needsContinuation: true }, 403)
    }
    return c.json({ error: errMsg }, 500)
  }

  const { sandbox: creds, links } = result.data
  log.info({
    projectId,
    sandboxId: creds?.id,
    host: creds?.ipv4,
    port: creds?.sshPort,
    agentUrl: links?.agentUrl?.url,
  }, 'sandbox acquired successfully')

  // Store agent URL server-side (always fresh)
  if (links?.agentUrl?.url) agentUrls.set(projectId, links.agentUrl.url)

  // Establish SSH connection eagerly
  log.debug({ projectId }, 'establishing SSH connection')
  try {
    await sshManager.getConnection(projectId)
    log.info({ projectId }, 'SSH connection established')
  } catch (err) {
    log.warn({ projectId, err: String(err) }, 'SSH connection failed (non-fatal for open)')
  }

  hub.broadcast(`project:${projectId}`, {
    type: 'workspace:opened',
    agentUrl: links?.agentUrl?.url,
    sandboxId: creds?.id,
  })

  log.info({ projectId }, 'workspace opened successfully')
  return c.json({
    ok: true,
    agentUrl: links?.agentUrl?.url,
    sandboxId: creds?.id,
    host: creds?.ipv4,
    port: creds?.sshPort,
  })
})
EOF

# Vibecode Studio — Fixes & Improvements

## Critical Server Bugs Fixed

### `server/ssh/manager.ts` — Complete rewrite
- **FIXED**: Duplicate `private failures` declaration (two conflicting types) — TypeScript would not compile
- **FIXED**: `failCounts` and `failures` maps doing overlapping things — merged into single clean `FailState` map
- **FIXED**: DNS errors (`lookup api.vibecodeapp.com: server misbehaving`) were being treated same as auth errors, causing permanent 5-minute backoff instead of transient retry
- **FIXED**: Cached credentials NOT cleared when SSH connect (not acquire) fails — next retry would reuse stale creds
- **NEW**: Error classifier: `auth` (Forbidden/401/403) vs `transient` (DNS/ECONNREFUSED/timeout) vs `unknown`
- **NEW**: Per-kind backoff: auth=3 failures/5min, transient=20 failures/90s
- **NEW**: Compact logging: first 3 failures logged normally, then single "suppressing" message until recovery

### `server/routes/chat.ts` — Double stream:end bug fixed
- **FIXED**: `/stop` endpoint AND background stream both broadcast `chat:stream:end` → double finalize on client
  - Now: when stream is aborted via `ac.signal`, background async fn returns early without broadcasting
  - Stop endpoint broadcasts immediately with `userStopped: true`
- **FIXED**: Removed duplicate `log.debug('background stream started')` that appeared twice
- **FIXED**: `cutOff` semantics: `cutOff=true` means had content but no `done` event; `empty=true` means no content at all; `userStopped=true` means user explicitly stopped

### `server/routes/continuation.ts` — TypeError fixed
- **FIXED**: `verify.data.projects.some(...)` → `TypeError: undefined is not an object`
  - `cli.listProjects()` returns `data` as `VibecodeProject[]` directly (not `{ projects: [] }`)
  - Fixed to `verify.data.some(...)`

### `server/routes/projects.ts`
- **FIXED**: `cliResult.data.projects.map(...)` → now correctly `cliResult.data.map(...)`

### `server/index.ts` — Startup delay eliminated
- **FIXED**: Orphan project cleanup was blocking server startup (5-10s wait for remote project list)
  - Now runs in background async IIFE — server starts immediately
- **FIXED**: Same `result.data.projects.map(...)` → `result.data.map(...)` bug

### `server/ws/hub.ts` — Log spam eliminated
- **FIXED**: `console.log` on every `subscribe()` and `broadcast()` call (100s/second during active use)
  - Replaced with `log.trace(...)` — only visible in dev with trace level enabled

### `server/ssh/watcher.ts`
- **FIXED**: Only stopped on "Forbidden" — now also stops on "SSH backed off (auth)" and "SSH backed off (unknown)"
- **NEW**: Transient errors (DNS, timeout) no longer stop the watcher — SSH manager handles backoff

### `server/lib/logger.ts`
- **FIXED**: `prettyStream` was logging at `debug` level in production — now `info` level minimum
- Browser WebSocket log forwarder now only sends `info+` (not debug noise)

## Client Bugs Fixed

### `client/src/store/chat.ts`
- **REMOVED**: 15+ `addClientLog()` calls on every state mutation (massive log noise even in production)
- **FIXED**: `finalizeStream` always created an assistant message even for user-stopped empty responses
  - Now: if `userStopped && !content` → just clears streaming state, no phantom empty message
- **NEW**: `Message` type has `empty`, `userStopped` fields for proper banner logic

### `client/src/hooks/useProjectEvents.ts`
- **FIXED**: `chat:stream:end` with `userStopped: true` and empty content → no longer calls `finalizeStream` with empty content (which would create confusing "no response" banner)
- **FIXED**: Proper handling of all three states: `userStopped`, `cutOff`, `empty`

### `client/src/components/workspace/ChatPanel.tsx`
- **FIXED**: `retryFromIndex(idx - 1)` — if first message was assistant, `idx - 1 = -1` → wrong behavior
  - Now searches backwards for the most recent user message
- **REMOVED**: Excessive `addClientLog()` calls throughout
- **IMPROVED**: Empty state with larger logo mark, better prompt suggestions
- **IMPROVED**: Thinking dots component extracted and polished

### `client/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx`
- **FIXED**: `cutOff` banner now only shows when there IS content (was possible to show on empty message)
- **NEW**: `userStopped` messages get no banner at all — user knows they stopped it
- **NEW**: Shared `Banner` component for cleaner code
- **IMPROVED**: Slightly refined visual polish

### `client/src/components/chat/ToolCallCard.tsx`

### `client/src/lib/serverLogs.ts`
- **FIXED**: `addClientLog` now no-ops in production (`import.meta.env.DEV` guard)

### `client/src/lib/ws.ts`
- **IMPROVED**: Quieter reconnect logic (no console.log spam)

  import type { ServerWebSocket } from 'bun'

  export type WSMessage =
    | { type: 'subscribe'; channels: string[] }
    | { type: 'unsubscribe'; channels: string[] }
    | { type: 'terminal:input'; terminalId: string; data: string }
    | { type: 'terminal:resize'; terminalId: string; cols: number; rows: number }
    | { type: 'ping' }

  class WebSocketHub {
    private clients = new Set<WebSocket>()
    private subscriptions = new Map<string, Set<WebSocket>>()

    addClient(ws: WebSocket) {
      this.clients.add(ws)
    }

    removeClient(ws: WebSocket) {
      this.clients.delete(ws)
      for (const [channel, subs] of this.subscriptions) {
        subs.delete(ws)
        if (subs.size === 0) this.subscriptions.delete(channel)
      }
    }

    subscribe(ws: WebSocket, channels: string[]) {
      console.log('[hub] subscribe:', JSON.stringify(channels), 'type:', typeof channels, 'isArray:', Array.isArray(channels))
      for (const channel of channels) {
        if (!this.subscriptions.has(channel)) this.subscriptions.set(channel, new Set())
        this.subscriptions.get(channel)!.add(ws)
      }
      console.log('[hub] total subscriptions:', this.subscriptions.size, 'channels:', Array.from(this.subscriptions.keys()))
    }

    unsubscribe(ws: WebSocket, channels: string[]) {
      for (const channel of channels) {
        this.subscriptions.get(channel)?.delete(ws)
      }
    }

    broadcast(channel: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) {
      const subs = this.subscriptions.get(channel)
      console.log('[hub] broadcast to', channel, '- subscribers:', subs?.size || 0, 'event:', data.type)
      if (!subs) return
      const payload = JSON.stringify(data)
      for (const ws of subs) {
        if (ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
          // Prune dead connections
          subs.delete(ws)
          this.clients.delete(ws)
          continue
        }
        try { ws.send(payload) } catch { subs.delete(ws); this.clients.delete(ws) }
      }
      if (subs.size === 0) this.subscriptions.delete(channel)
    }

    broadcastAll(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
      const payload = JSON.stringify(data)
      for (const ws of this.clients) {
        try {
          if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(payload)
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
    }

    handleMessage(ws: WebSocket, raw: string) {
      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(raw) as WSMessage
        switch (msg.type) {
          case 'subscribe':
            this.subscribe(ws, msg.channels)
            break
          case 'unsubscribe':
            this.unsubscribe(ws, msg.channels)
            break
          case 'ping':
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'pong' }))
            break
          case 'terminal:input':
          case 'terminal:resize':
            this.handleTerminalMessage(msg)
            break
        }
      } catch { /* malformed message */ }
    }

    private terminalHandlers = new Map<string, (msg: WSMessage) => void>()

    onTerminal(terminalId: string, handler: (msg: WSMessage) => void) {
      this.terminalHandlers.set(terminalId, handler)
      return () => { this.terminalHandlers.delete(terminalId) }
    }

    private handleTerminalMessage(msg: WSMessage) {
      if ('terminalId' in msg) {
        this.terminalHandlers.get(msg.terminalId)?.(msg)
      }
    }

    get clientCount() { return this.clients.size }
  }

  export const wsHub = new WebSocketHub()

  import { createLogger } from '../lib/logger.ts'

  const log = createLogger('streams')

  interface ActiveStream {
    sessionId: string
    projectId: string
    abort: AbortController
    startedAt: Date
  }

  class StreamRegistry {
    private streams = new Map<string, ActiveStream>()

    register(sessionId: string, projectId: string, abort: AbortController) {
      this.streams.set(sessionId, { sessionId, projectId, abort, startedAt: new Date() })
      log.debug({ sessionId, projectId, total: this.streams.size }, 'stream registered')
    }

    unregister(sessionId: string) {
      this.streams.delete(sessionId)
      log.debug({ sessionId, total: this.streams.size }, 'stream unregistered')
    }

    abort(sessionId: string, reason = 'aborted') {
      const stream = this.streams.get(sessionId)
      if (!stream) return false
      log.info({ sessionId, reason }, 'aborting stream')
      stream.abort.abort(reason)
      this.streams.delete(sessionId)
      return true
    }

    abortAll(reason = 'server shutdown') {
      const count = this.streams.size
      if (count === 0) return
      log.warn({ count, reason }, 'aborting all active streams')
      for (const [sessionId, stream] of this.streams) {
        log.info({ sessionId, projectId: stream.projectId, reason }, 'auto-stopping stream')
        stream.abort.abort(reason)
      }
      this.streams.clear()
    }

    getActive() {
      return [...this.streams.values()]
    }
  }

  export const streamRegistry = new StreamRegistry()
